verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Square hosts a working llms.txt at developer.squareup.com/llms.txt returning HTTP 200 with a descriptive summary of its APIs/SDKs, directly satisfying the story; Square also documents an MCP server for agent access. Missing for 10: no docs.md or OpenAPI machine-readable fallback (both 404), and no independent/community confirmation of agents successfully using llms.txt.
